decision_conditions: The extractor system hereby permitted shall be operating at a maximum frequency of 37 Hz at any given time of use. Reason: To safeguard the amenities currently enjoyed by the occupants of adjoining premises and/or dwellings in accordance with policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Planning Fire Safety Strategy Plan prepared by J.S.O Fire Safety Consultants dated 22/07/2025.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
